# AI Receptionist for Therapists
> Antek Automation builds AI receptionists for UK therapists and counsellors from £497 setup, set up by Andy Norman, that answer during sessions and book first appointments.

## About Antek Automation

## What this site covers
- AI call answering for counsellors, psychotherapists, physiotherapists and small private practices in the UK
- Setup from £497 and from £97 a month, with the scope agreed in writing
- Limits: no clinical advice or assessment, callers told it is an AI, and callers who appear at risk given 999 and Samaritans on 116 123
- Data location, retention and software connections are confirmed in each client's scope before go-live

## Key facts
- Answers as: Your practice's name, and says it is an AI
- Offers: First appointments from your diary
- Never gives: Clinical advice or assessment
- Set up by: Andy Norman, Antek Automation
- Call: 0333 038 9960
